newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS BOND PRICES END FIRM DESPITE SWAPS TREND.
newsitem.headline: SWISS BOND PRICES END FIRM DESPITE SWAPS TREND.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Swiss bond prices ended firmer despite rising short-term interest rates, which left Swiss bonds expensive relative to swaps, traders said.
* Sept Conf futures ended up 17 basis points at 120.07
* 4-1/2 pct June 07 federal bond yields 3.457 pct vs 3.47 pct
